verdict.rationale: Mem0 supports a coarse form of temporal management via `expiration_date`, which stops surfacing a memory after a set date without deleting it (mem0-docs-11, mem0-docs-19, mem0-docs-37, mem0-docs-50), and update logic that lets agents 'update what it already knows' (mem0-docs-2). However, this is manual expiration, not true temporal reasoning that tracks when a fact became valid/invalid or automatically supersedes outdated facts with a validity timeline. Missing for 10: explicit valid_from/valid_to metadata on facts, automatic contradiction/versioning detection between old and new facts, and any documentation or example showing the system reasoning about fact recency/validity windows.
